_what: Engine 1.1.0 configuration. Same thresholds as DISC-P1-v1 (config/phase1.json, the record of ledger entries 1-2); the engine itself changed: E1 de-vig sensitivity evaluated on the fights where each method is defined and never passed vacuously, E2 the 0.003 size test against the re-weighted market (raw-market gain reported beside it, owner decision D-034), E3 H1-contamination flags. No real-data run has used this config yet. Commit this file before the first real run that uses it (E4: DISC-P1-v1 was committed after its first run had started). Values marked 'pred001' are read from research/protocol/protocol.json at run time and the run refuses to start if this file disagrees.
